explanation: Only the randomised test compares groups that are alike apart from the newsletter, so the effect is (0.044 - 0.040) / 0.040 = 0.10, a 10% relative lift. The comparison of subscribers with everyone else, (0.09 - 0.04) / 0.04 = 125%, mixes the newsletter's effect with who chooses to subscribe: engaged customers sign up and buy more anyway.
